These are research prompts at neighborhood scale—not approved works, confirmed planting spots, or detected satellite anomalies.

    04 / BEHIND THE MAP

    Evidence before
    intervention.

    Satellite data can reveal land cover, vegetation patterns, and surface thermal conditions at useful scales. It cannot tell us who owns a footpath, where a tree can legally grow, whether a roof is structurally sound, or whether a proposed project will actually improve air temperature.

    01

    Observe

    Bring in Sentinel-2 / Dynamic World land cover, Landsat surface temperature, official boundaries and validated local layers.

    02

    Investigate

    Analyze candidate areas, compare current conditions, and identify specific gaps for field surveys and expert review.

    03

    Approve

    Check landowner permission, utilities, water demand, safety, biodiversity, city rules and local implementers.

    04

    Verify

    Document projects that actually occur, then follow up using measured outcomes instead of simulated savings.

    AREA-LEVEL SATELLITE EVIDENCE

    CURRENT DATA STATUS: CURATED PILOT

    The twelve mapped proposals are examples attached to actual Dubai neighborhoods. They have not yet been scored with live satellite pixels or field survey data. A reproducible Earth Engine export workflow is included for a future evidenced release.
